text:
rachel-sales: Heads-up  Sentinel Health execs just escalated. Two decisive asks before legal signs: (1) formal discount for a 36mo reserved commit, (2) SIEM / audit-log integration + EU-only processing guarantee. They also said performance in the demo diverges from their expected production workload.
diego-se: saw the demo run. Reproced: throughput drops during long-context multi-turns. Attaching short log snippet.
josh-eng: paste logs: ```
2026-05-09T08:42:11Z worker-2 WARN batch_window exceeded target 150ms -> 320ms
2026-05-09T08:42:12Z kvcache miss rate 14% seq=8192
2026-05-09T08:42:13Z worker-2 INFO throughput 7600 tokens/s
```
diego-se: Looks like prefix-heavy prompts + long seqlen. We can mitigate with prefix-only caching + bumping kv-shards but need a dedicated pool.
meera-ops: For EU-only processing we can either provision a Dedicated pool in eu-north-1 or offer a Private deployment. Dedicated pool is faster (2-3 days), Private is 6-8 weeks and requires customer infra. Ops surcharge applies either way.
priya-legal: Discount ask for 36mo: what's the proposed band? Also they asked for SIEM integration (Splunk/Elastic) and a 10-year audit-log retention. We need scoping for retention and export.
laura-gm: From GTM: they want a firm number today to push to CFO. If we can't give 36mo number they may walk. Recommend we float a capped concession with guardrails.
josh-eng: Quick repro command for their engineers: ```
REDWOOD_ENV=sentinel-demo REDWOOD_POOL=8 REDWOOD_KV_SHARDS=32 redwood run --seq-len 8192 --continuous-batching=true
```
meera-ops: I'll spin a dedicated eu-north-1 pool (pool=8, q5b model) and run a 3h soak. Deploy command: 
```
redwood deploy --env sentinel-dedicated --region eu-north-1 --pool-size 8 --kv-shards 32 --model q5b/redwood-prod
```
infra-bot: deployment sentinel-dedicated queued by meera-ops at 2026-05-09T09:02:05Z. job id: d4c3b2. Estimated ready in ~45m.
josh-eng: initial soak (30m) numbers: sustained 9.6k tokens/s, p50=25ms, p95=260ms, kvcache miss=4.1%. No evictions so far. Full 3h artifacts will be uploaded.
diego-se: Good improvement. I'll create a minimal tuning gist for them with the exact knobs and a fallback plan (increase kv shards and enable prefix caching).
priya-legal: For SIEM: we can stream audit events to customer's Splunk via HTTPS collector. Ten-year retention is heavier; need cost estimate. I'll draft contract language requiring customer to acknowledge storage costs above 5 years.
laura-gm: Pricing: propose 22% off list for 36mo if they sign a non-refundable first 6 months and an annual usage floor. If they want 30% ask, require a 48mo term + higher floor. Thoughts?
meera-ops: Ops surcharge for Dedicated eu-north-1: one-time provisioning fee $40k + monthly dedicated ops $12k. Private deploy would be +$80k onboarding + $18k monthly.
josh-eng: Perf report link (partial): https://redwood-internal/soaks/sentinel/1836001234/summary.txt
diego-se: Action items: 
- meera-ops: finish soak + upload artifacts (ETA 1h)
- josh-eng: produce perf one-pager + tuning gist (ETA 2h)
- priya-legal: draft redline with SIEM/export and retention language (ETA EOD)
- laura-gm: prepare exec note with pricing bands and suggested ask/ask-backs (ETA EOD)
rachel-sales: I'll coordinate with AE and the customer. If we can land the 22% with the 6mo non-refund today we can schedule a signing call for next week. :thumbsup:
infra-bot: reminder: presales sync for Sentinel Health at 2026-05-09T10:00:00Z -> https://meet.redwood/sentinel-brief-10m
